description: Check one domain (or its parent domains) or IPv4 address against ThreatCluster's high-confidence 30-day IOC feed: is it listed as attacker infrastructure (C2, phishing, malware delivery) in recent threat reporting? Returns listed/not_listed, match type, reason, linked reports and clusters. Use it before opening a link, in email triage or SOC enrichment. Not listed is not proof of safety. Served from an hourly cache; a stale feed returns an error and is not charged. Costs $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (payment goes in _meta["x402/payment"]); invalid input or an upstream failure returns an error and is not charged.

q.description: Domain, URL or IPv4, e.g. evil.example or 203.0.113.7

name: indicator_check
